description: Saffire IV-VI large-scale solid flammability tests in Cygnus at elevated O2, extracted from NASA NTRS papers

tests.material: SIBAL cloth (75 pct cotton, 25 pct fiberglass), 50 cm long
tests.outcome: Burned. Steady spread over the sample; spread rate 3.6 mm/s. Average heat release 3,150 W and 409 kJ total by fuel consumption calorimetry, burn duration 130 s
